facts.fact: Biometric Update reported on 31 July 2026 that the authorities, through the director-general of the Civil Registry directorate, are working out plans to digitise civil registration and the national ID system and link them, so that births are declared to the civil registry from health facilities as they happen; it is a plan, with no system in operation described.

The planned digital civil registration is led by the Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration, which says it is to be the body issuing birth certificates, with the Ministries of Justice, Interior and Health collaborating (director-general Elia Costa, reported 31 July 2026).
